Detailed: TSYS digital temperature sensor. It includes a temperature sensing chip and a 24-bit ΔΣ-ADC.
Response Time: 1 second (with 0.5 m/s flow) and 2 seconds (in still water).

Detailed: Wang, B., Cai, H., Jia, Q., Pan, H., Li, B., & Fu, L. (2023). Smart Temperature Sensor Design and High-Density Water Temperature Monitoring in Estuarine and Coastal Areas. Sensors, 23(17), 7659.
